payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and metrics used to measure the quality of word vectors, including the use of Pearson correlation coefficient and the evaluation of word similarity scores against human judgment.

claims.text: The quality of word vectors is measured by computing the Pearson correlation coefficient between human judgment of word similarity and the cosine distances in vector space.
Higher Pearson correlation coefficients indicate better quality of word vectors.
The choice of noise distribution in models like Word2Vec affects the quality of learned word vectors.
